scope: metadata projection, cost index and path-bound raw-record integrity of the actual local collection
statement: RESULTS.json projects the existing native result and checker fields without new curve/group/rank arithmetic. COST_INDEX.json indexes retained process clocks and identifies nested totals and unpriced scopes. RECORDS.json binds the path-bound raw sources, inputs, results, controls and clocks by SHA256 while distinguishing generated local-only executable files. No independent signature or complete original map-synthesis cost is inferred.
